texts.about_this_item: Kotoffey hygienic cat litter with large granules, especially recommended for long-haired cats as the granules do not get caught in the coat. It neutralises unpleasant odours throughout use, is dust-free and does not stick to paws. The antibacterial properties of natural clay help prevent the growth of harmful microorganisms. Heat-treated and safe if accidentally swallowed.
